primary_sources.title: Admissible online closed testing must employ e-values
primary_sources.verified_scope: Supplement S.5 defines predictable truncation threshold m_t and permits scalar or general boosted maps provided E[T_t(E_t^boost)|F_{t-1}]<=1 under the null. Proposition S.1 gives the simultaneous true-discovery guarantee and explicitly says the construction is specific to the query path used to build the boosted e-values; other paths must use the truncated sequential e-values and may lose power.

primary_sources.title: Inverse Sampling for McNemar's Test
primary_sources.author: Mark Von Tress
primary_sources.publication: International Journal of Statistics and Probability 6(1), 2017
primary_sources.verified_scope: The source explicitly studies sampling until a pre-specified r discordant pairs are observed. Its likelihood decomposition includes a negative-binomial component for total pairs needed to obtain r discordances and a binomial component for the discordant outcomes; the exact-binomial sample size is thereby fixed.

independent_recalculation.result: The worker's reported worked-example calibration values reproduce to numerical precision from the Binomial(20,1/2) null law.

verified_worker_derivations: The individual-task scalar-boost impossibility is correct for the stated null class: if discordance probability rho_t=0 is allowed, the per-task e-value is identically 1; with m_t>1, any scalar b_t>1 makes the truncated boosted expectation min(b_t,m_t)>1. This rules out nontrivial unconditional scalar multiplication at that factor level, not non-scalar maps.

For fixed r discordant signs and directional null sign probability p<=1/2, the candidate-side sign betting factor with q_bet>1/2 has one-step null expectation <=1, with equality at p=1/2. Thus the equality-null Binomial(r,1/2) law is least favorable for this monotone bet under the ordinary fixed-discordant iid-pair model.
The floor transform is allowed in principle by Fischer-Ramdas because Supplement S.5 permits functions other than x->b x, provided the conditional truncated-null expectation criterion holds.

scope_corrections.correction: Von Tress supports inverse sampling for the ordinary McNemar paired-observation model. Porting the exact Binomial(r,1/2) calibration to an adaptive evaluation harness requires the within-audit discordant signs to satisfy the corresponding iid/exchangeable or conditional-null structure. If benchmark items are adaptively selected based on earlier outcomes, that assumption must be separately established; the 2017 source does not supply it automatically.

The boost is not a universal improvement to all SeqE-Guard queries. Proposition S.1 is explicitly tied to the query path for which the boosted values were constructed; other query paths use truncated boosted values and can be weaker.

The worker's 100,000-run power/FWER stress tests and late-signal-collapse numerics are worker-local simulations, not results of the cited primary papers. This audit independently recalculated only the finite-support worked-example calibration, not the Monte Carlo tables.

The product late-signal collapse argument is a worker derivation. Its iid fixed-transform log-drift statement is mathematically plausible under the stated integrability assumptions, but it is not a theorem quoted from Fischer-Ramdas and adaptive/dependent streams need additional conditional-drift or ergodic conditions.

assessment: The core inverse-discordant + query-path boosting construction is technically well grounded: its primary-source ingredients match, and the published finite-support calibration example in the worker artifact independently recomputes exactly. The main deployment guard is sampling-model validity: fixing the number of discordances removes the discordance-rate nuisance only if the discordant sign sequence retains the required null law under the actual audit sampling policy.
exact_next_action: For evaluation follow-up, verify or explicitly encode the sampling-policy condition that makes fixed-discordant signs conditionally valid under adaptive benchmark selection; otherwise use fresh nonadaptive audit items. Rotate primary verification to another C14 namespace before returning to worker-local Monte Carlo claims.
